meta.description: Global n8n error workflow. Categorizes retryable vs non-retryable failures, records sanitized dead-letter events (no message bodies, no PII), groups repetitive Slack alerts, and provides a safe idempotency-preserving replay entry point. Never replays a send already accepted by Sendblue.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ replay: $('Replay Verdict').first().json.replay, reason: $('Replay Verdict').first().json.reason || 'marked for replay — re-trigger the source workflow with the original correlation id; idempotency claims make it safe', event_id: $('Replay Verdict').first().json.event ? $('Replay Verdict').first().json.event.event_id : null }) }}
